changes.change: python-ci and node-ci send the browser job's coverage to SonarQube Cloud too: the browser job uploads what browser-test writes to browser-coverage-report (default coverage/) as the coverage-browser artifact, and the sonar job waits for it, reading every coverage* artifact. A repository can move its browser tests out of the test command into browser-test, where they run beside the unit tests, without losing their coverage. Later jobs in the run can download the same coverage* artifacts
